paragraphs.source_en: Last night I dreamed I entered a dark valley, I heard the cuckoo weep blood in a clump of lilies, Last night I dreamed I climbed to a high peak, and saw a tear of light fall from the sky. Outside ancient Rome lies a burial ground, where silent stone still lies over the bodies of tragedies from a hundred years ago; A hundred years later, the black cart-wheels of Hades again roared again beside the green woods of Pandonborlo. If the universe is a cruel machine, why does this bright-lamp-like ideal still flash before us? You say creation is the embodiment of truth, goodness, and beauty— then why does the five-colored rainbow refuse to linger in the sky? Though we met only once, the time we had—those twenty minutes—does not die. Who can believe your transcendent beauty and grace, that it should already have left the world, fading like dawn dew? No. Life is only a dream of substance: its beautiful soul is forever the beloved of God. Three decades of short lodging in life are only a flower of hot-house dreams appearing once, and within tears I long to see you smile as you return to the realm of immortals. Do you remember our promise in London, Manshifei-er? This summer we met again by Lake Geneva. Lake Geneva forever bears the shadow of snow on the white cliffs of Blanki, and that day I gazed at cloud and sky, weeping in scattered tears. When I first heard the news of life, I felt, as if waking from a dream, the solemnity of love at once. The awakening of life is the adulthood of love: now, because of death, I feel again the limits and shorelines of life and passion. Because love is a crystal jewel no blow can break, love is the sole path by which life is fulfilled: death is a great mysterious furnace in which the divine spirits of all things are refined. How can my grieving thoughts race like bolts of lightning? How can they move your far-off soul beneath heaven and bring it near? I cast my tears into the wind and send them far, asking when I may break through the gate of life and death. Written on March 11, 1923.

units.source_zh:
我昨夜夢入幽谷，

聽子規在百合叢中泣血，

我昨夜夢登高峰，

見一顆光明淚自天墜落。

units.source_en: Outside ancient Rome lies a burial ground, where silent stone still lies over the bodies of tragedies from a hundred years ago;
units.source_zh:
古羅馬的郊外有座墓園，

靜偃著百年前客殤的詩骸；

units.source_en: A hundred years later, the black cart-wheels of Hades again roared again beside the green woods of Pandonborlo.
units.source_zh:
百年後海岱士黑輦的車輪，

又喧響在芳丹卜羅的青林邊。

units.source_en: If the universe is a cruel machine, why does this bright-lamp-like ideal still flash before us?
units.source_zh:
說宇宙是無情的機械，

為甚明燈似的理想閃耀在前？

ja.t: れだというのなら、 なぜ

units.source_zh:
說造化是真善美之表現，

為甚五彩虹不常住天邊？

units.source_en: Though we met only once, the time we had—those twenty minutes—does not die.
units.source_zh:
我與你雖僅一度相見──

但那二十分不死的時間！

units.source_en: Who can believe your transcendent beauty and grace, that it should already have left the world, fading like dawn dew?

ja.t: れたはずだということを。

units.source_zh:
誰能信你那仙姿靈態，

竟已朝露似的永別人間？

units.source_en: Life is only a dream of substance: its beautiful soul is forever the beloved of God.
units.source_zh:
生命只是個實體的幻夢：

美麗的靈魂，永承上帝的愛寵；

units.source_en: Three decades of short lodging in life are only a flower of hot-house dreams appearing once, and within tears I long to see you smile as you return to the realm of immortals.
units.source_zh:
三十年小住，只似曇花之偶現，

淚花裏我想見你笑歸仙宮。

units.source_en: Do you remember our promise in London, Manshifei-er?

ja.t: えているかしら、マンシュフェイエリ？

units.source_zh: 你記否倫敦約言，曼殊斐兒！

units.source_en: This summer we met again by Lake Geneva.
units.source_zh: 今夏再見於琴妮湖之邊；

units.source_en: Lake Geneva forever bears the shadow of snow on the white cliffs of Blanki, and that day I gazed at cloud and sky, weeping in scattered tears.
units.source_zh:
琴妮湖永抱著白朗磯的雪影，

此日我悵望雲天，淚下點點！

units.source_en: When I first heard the news of life, I felt, as if waking from a dream, the solemnity of love at once.
units.source_zh:
我當年初臨生命的消息，

夢覺似的驟感戀愛之莊嚴；

units.source_en: The awakening of life is the adulthood of love: now, because of death, I feel again the limits and shorelines of life and passion.
units.source_zh:
生命的覺悟是愛之成年，

我今又因死而感生與戀之涯沿！

units.source_en: Because love is a crystal jewel no blow can break, love is the sole path by which life is fulfilled: death is a great mysterious furnace in which the divine spirits of all things are refined.

ja.t: のるつぼであり、 そこでは

units.source_zh:
因情是摜不破的純晶，

愛是實現生命之唯一途徑：

死是座偉祕的洪爐，此中

凝煉萬象所從來之神明。

units.source_en: How can my grieving thoughts race like bolts of lightning? How can they move your far-off soul beneath heaven and bring it near?

ja.t: させることができるだろうか。

units.source_zh:
我哀思焉能電花似的飛騁，

感動你在天日遙遠的靈魂？

units.source_en: I cast my tears into the wind and send them far, asking when I may break through the gate of life and death.
units.source_zh:
我灑淚向風中遙送，

問何時能戡破生死之門？

paragraphs.source_zh:
我昨夜夢入幽谷，

聽子規在百合叢中泣血，

我昨夜夢登高峰，

見一顆光明淚自天墜落。

古羅馬的郊外有座墓園，

靜偃著百年前客殤的詩骸；

百年後海岱士黑輦的車輪，

又喧響在芳丹卜羅的青林邊。

說宇宙是無情的機械，

為甚明燈似的理想閃耀在前？

說造化是真善美之表現，

為甚五彩虹不常住天邊？

我與你雖僅一度相見──

但那二十分不死的時間！

誰能信你那仙姿靈態，

竟已朝露似的永別人間？

非也！生命只是個實體的幻夢：

美麗的靈魂，永承上帝的愛寵；

三十年小住，只似曇花之偶現，

淚花裏我想見你笑歸仙宮。

你記否倫敦約言，曼殊斐兒！

今夏再見於琴妮湖之邊；

琴妮湖永抱著白朗磯的雪影，

此日我悵望雲天，淚下點點！

我當年初臨生命的消息，

夢覺似的驟感戀愛之莊嚴；

生命的覺悟是愛之成年，

我今又因死而感生與戀之涯沿！

因情是摜不破的純晶，

愛是實現生命之唯一途徑：

死是座偉祕的洪爐，此中

凝煉萬象所從來之神明。

我哀思焉能電花似的飛騁，

感動你在天日遙遠的靈魂？

我灑淚向風中遙送，

問何時能戡破生死之門？

一九二三年三月十一日作
